name: desktop-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of desktop applications, kept locally: Electron (guides, tutorials, every API), electron-builder (targets, Windows installers, signing, auto-update), the Electron tools (Packager, Rebuild, Fuses, ASAR), Tauri 2 (guides, configuration, plugins, distribution), the cross-compilation of Rust for Windows (cross, cargo-xwin), Wine and its tools, the NSIS and WiX installers, and MSIX packaging. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of desktop applications: Electron APIs (BrowserWindow, ipcMain, contextBridge...), electron-builder configuration and targets (nsis, msi, appx, AppImage), Electron Packager, Rebuild, Fuses, ASAR, Tauri 2 (tauri.conf.json, commands, plugins, bundling for Windows), cross and cargo-xwin, Wine (winegcc, widl, msiexec), NSIS script commands, WiX, MSIX. Returns 10 section ids at most.
